page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading above it, the closing word FIN. and a woodcut ornament below. The running head is at the top, the page number at top right. The left edge carries cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page, which are not transcribed.

main_text.l: [?]lore de Peluse, ou Belbeis, en l'epistre
Il faut que ceux qui sont studieux, con-
ssans[?] qu'il y va du danger de leur ame,
que rien ne doit estre premier en cons-
ideration que la verité ; & pensans de plus
les maux que la haine & preoccupation
engendrent, se rendent auditeurs communs à
ceux qui parlent des deux costez ; non

page.notes: The first letter of the heading is cut off by the left edge and is uncertain. The hyphenated word "con-" at the line end is followed by a long-s form that I could not read with certainty. The woodcut ornament below FIN. is not text and is not transcribed. The heading's reference line "130 du 4 livre." is kept as printed in the same heading.
